missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Шинель' is a feminine soft-sign noun in the nominative, the subject of 'висит'. 'Эта' agrees in the feminine, and 'на вешалке' gives the location.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Шинель' is the accusative direct object of 'надел'; this feminine soft-sign noun looks identical to the nominative. 'Старую серую' are agreeing feminine accusative adjectives.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Шинели' is the genitive form required after 'не было'. The frame 'у солдата не было' states the absence of the overcoat.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'к'. 'К шинели' uses the dative form 'шинели' to show motion toward the coat. 'Пуговицу' is the accusative object of 'пришил'.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Шинелью' is the instrumental form governed by 'гордился'. 'Своей новой' are agreeing feminine instrumental adjectives expressing pride in the coat.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'На шинели' uses the prepositional form 'шинели' after 'на' to locate the collar. 'Воротник' is the nominative subject of 'был'.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after numeral. After 'две' the noun takes the genitive singular form 'шинели'. 'В шкафу' gives the location of the two coats.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Шинели' is the nominative plural subject of 'лежат'. 'Старые' is the agreeing plural adjective, and 'в углу' marks the location.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after 'много'. 'Шинелей' is the genitive plural required by 'много'. 'Старых' agrees in the genitive plural describing the old overcoats.
Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Шинель' is the nominative subject, and 'тёплая' is the agreeing feminine short-form-like predicate adjective. 'Зимой' adds the seasonal context.
